title: Digital Engineering Lead
description: Implementing Building Information Modeling (BIM) workflows. Designing engineering data architecture for predictive quantity estimation (AI/ML-ready datasets) CDE setup, document digitalization, and workflow optimization.

title: Senior Engineer (Value Engineering Group)
description: Led the evaluation of structural and architectural designs prepared by engineering teams from both technical and economic standpoints. One case involved applying section 6.7.2 of ACI 313-16, allowing the neglect of overpressure effects from stored material in silo foundation design. This optimization eliminated the need for 71 concrete piles (each 25 meters long), significantly reducing construction costs.
